news.title: Luda Technology Signs Pipeline-Fittings Supply Agreement for China Refining Project
Luda Technology Group Limited has signed a sales blanket agreement worth about RMB1.6 billion to supply pipeline fittings for the Yulong Island Refining and Chemical Integration Project (Phase one).
